title: acaena pumila var. glaberrima
intro: Acaena pumila var. glaberrima, commonly known as Dwarf Bluebush, is a shrubby perennial plant native to New Zealand. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Bluebush are attributed to its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and swelling, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
